reference.title: Scenario 4 — Consecutive headings with no body content
reference.shortdesc: Consider a document where multiple consecutive headings at any level contain no body content between

section.p: Consider a document where multiple consecutive headings at any level contain no body content between them.

table.title: Consecutive headings with no body content

row.entry: [Heading 1]: Installation [Heading 2]: Prerequisites [Heading 3]: System Requirements [Normal]: System requires 4 GB RAM. (No body under Heading 1 or Heading 2)

section.p: Result:Each heading without body content becomes a <topichead>. The first heading with body content becomes a real DITA topic referenced with <topicref>.
section.note: Add at least a short introductory paragraph under major headings when the heading should become a real topic instead of a navigation-only <topichead>.
